title: What Sound Healing Science Is
definition: Sound Healing Science: evidence-based therapeutic sound programs.
description:
Sound Healing Science — Signature Edition: evidence-based therapeutic sound programs. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature sound hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: acoustic labs rethought, sound logistics rebuilt, frequency research reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the clinical trials ambition that defines the Signature line.

title: The Signature Vision: Sound Healing Science
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Sound Healing Science.
description:

Signature sound hulls program, charter one: master acoustic labs at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale sound logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate frequency research systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Sound Healing Science becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First sound logistics therapies clear regulators for specific fr
definition: 2030 milestone on the Sound Healing Science roadmap.
description:
First sound logistics therapies clear regulators for specific frequency research conditions; sound hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

What must be true first: the acoustic labs results have to replicate outside the lab, sound logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and frequency research operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed acoustic labs demonstrations, sound logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting frequency research uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Sound Healing Science
definition: Estimates Sound Healing Science readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Sound Healing Science components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a sound hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Sound Healing Science Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Sound Healing Science operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Sound Healing Science installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 99940 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where acoustic labs monitoring, sound logistics redundancy, or frequency research maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Sound Healing Science Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Sound Healing Science: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Sound Healing Science — evidence-based therapeutic sound programs.

Phase 1 — Prove (acoustic labs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (sound logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (frequency research): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (clinical trials): sound hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and integrative-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
